_description: Contract schema for Rise FC schema operator output bundle manifests. Defines required fields for a compliant output bundle. This is a contract definition only — not a real run artifact.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this governed schema run. Format: RUN_NNN_PAGEFAMILY_MODE.

targetUrl.description: Full URL of the target page for this run.

targetRoute.description: Route path of the target page.

schemaProfile.description: Active schema profile identifier for this run.

truthFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the truth-pack reference used in this run.

allowedModules.description: List of schema modules authorized for this profile.

blockedModules.description: List of schema modules explicitly blocked for this profile.

heldFields.description: List of held field categories not emitted in this run.

evidenceMapStatus.description: Status of the evidence map for this run.

validationStatus.description: Overall validation status after external validator review.

controllerDecisionStatus.description: Final controller decision status after all review steps.

humanApprovalStatus.description: Status of human approval for implementation handoff.

implementationStatus.description: Current implementation status of this output bundle.

schemaOutputCreated.description: Whether a schema output (JSON-LD draft) was produced in this run.

heldFieldsEmitted.description: Whether any held fields were emitted. Must be false for a compliant bundle.

blockedModulesUsed.description: Whether any blocked modules were used. Must be false for a compliant bundle.

contentInvented.description: Whether any content was invented (not anchored to Phase 0 or page evidence). Must be false.

phase0Mutated.description: Whether Phase 0 source was mutated. Must be false.

sourceTruthMutated.description: Whether source truth was mutated. Must be false.

runDate.description: ISO 8601 date of the governed run.

humanApprover.description: Name of the human who granted implementation approval.

humanApprovalDate.description: ISO 8601 date human approval was granted.

modulesImplemented.description: List of schema module types included in the final implementation.
